subject.title: fix(zalouser): settle waitForExit when abort signal already fired

question: Is the production gateway/monitor test with a mocked Zalo SDK sufficient for this shutdown-race fix, or should merge require a configured-account stop/restart result?
rationale: Only a maintainer can set the acceptable external-service proof bar for ZaloUser because the submitted proof deliberately excludes the configured-account and live-service boundary.

options.title: Require configured-account proof
options.body: Request a redacted real ZaloUser account stop/restart transcript, terminal output, or logs that show the shutdown settles promptly.

options.title: Accept the gateway-boundary proof
options.body: Record that the focused production monitor path and regression coverage are sufficient despite the unavailable live-account boundary.

recommendation.title: Require configured-account proof
recommendation.body: Request a redacted real ZaloUser account stop/restart transcript, terminal output, or logs that show the shutdown settles promptly.

likelyOwner.reason: Visible PR activity indicates awareness of the requested proof-acceptance decision, though repository-history ownership could not be confirmed.
